message: I once found myself with enough flashlights and batteries to light up a small city during a storm. My grandkids thought I was preparing for a power outage or a camping trip, but really, I was just enjoying a little peace of mind. Sometimes it’s nice to be the gloriously over-prepared person in the room — at least I won't have to scramble when the lights go out. What’s your favorite way to be ready for unexpected weather?
